stories.headline: Oil Prices Rebound Amid Renewed Middle East Supply Concerns
stories.summary: Crude oil prices rebounded from four-week lows as traders shifted focus back to the Middle East conflict, with Brent crude trading at $103.60 per barrel.
stories.why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity and energy input, with its price directly influencing inflation, transportation costs, and the margins of energy-intensive industries worldwide.
